prompts.name: 01-coffee
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one standalone small website quiz icon. Input images 1 and 2 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: use their exceptionally simple translucent frosted-glass silhouettes, soft interior blue gradient, thin luminous milky-white edge, gentle rounded contours, airy lightweight material. Do NOT recreate the posters or any lettering/logos/background. The consuming webpage uses muted steel blue #6789BE, pale mist blue #B7C9DE and ice white #EEF3FC. Match these colors, with a slightly deeper desaturated blue core for visibility on pale cards. No vivid royal blue, no purple, no warm colors. True transparent alpha background outside the object. Minimal front-facing 2.5D frosted translucent glass emblem, not a photoreal object, not a solid clay toy. No dark outlines, no hand-drawing, no textures, no scenery, no cast shadow, no square backdrop, no text. Centered square composition, icon occupies 75% of canvas, with generous transparent margin. Smooth subtle glass depth and delicate rim highlight. Keep recognizability at 120 pixels. Subject: a minimal takeaway coffee cup with a rounded lid and one broad sleeve, two tiny curved wisps of steam above. At bottom right a small simple frosted-blue clock disk with only two white hands, no numerals or tick marks, 25% of cup height. Cup is the hero. Use a few simple shapes, white luminous edges and airy blue center like the reference chat bubble. No brand logo, no facial expression.
